hadith:
Paid in Advance - Narrated by Muhammad bin Abi Al-Mujalid -  Volume 3, Book 35, Number 448 

As above (446) and said, "We used to pay them in advance for wheat and barley (to be delivered later). Narrated Ash-Shaibani--"And also for oil."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Qaadir - الْقَادِرُ - The Powerful

The name Al Qaadir is derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r', which denotes strength and capability. This name reflects the belief that Allah has complete control over the universe and is capable of exercising His will in all matters. It emphasizes the concept of divine power and authority in Islamic theology.
verse:
An-Naml - The Ant - 27:58

And We poured upon them a rain ˹of brimstone˺. How evil was the rain of those who had been warned!
